purpose: Same-budget ordinary initial-record order augmentation against the original canonical training; generic shared bottleneck remains a feasibility baseline.
objective: Only gold numeric-answer plus newline LM cross-entropy, identical for all arms. No auxiliary consistency loss or external scope labels.
gate: Require independent audit of the original native, four trained canonical arms, and all five frozen order-control models before any new training. Same model, packages, adapter shapes and initial state hashes; at least one native readout error.
requirements: Preserve the exact original ordered list of 864 training identities, answers, query tokens/positions and per-example optimized input lengths. Deterministically derange only the first eight independent initial SETs for streams 1 and 2 of each task; retain canonical streams 0 and 3. Each task/length has one stream of each order.

Use the original frozen backbone, full history, exact same controller parameter allocations and initialization hashes, identical answer-only LM loss and optimizer settings. Each arm gets one pass, 432 steps, 527808 input tokens and 3456 supervised answer tokens. No consistency losses or oracle scope labels.

Run all four one-update safety controls before scheduled training; verify zero-init identity, adapter gradients, frozen backbone and sampled question-only prefix identity. Scratch safety updates are discarded; reset each fresh controller to the registered seed and verify its original initial-state hash.

Save adapter/AdamW/RNG checkpoints at 144/288/432. Evaluate only final weights on both complete 432-example development orders, with separate final teacher fit on all 864 augmented training examples. Do not select checkpoints or tune hyperparameters on these results.

Verify actual six-layer full historical access, unchanged evaluated adapter states/RNG, sampled native restoration after detach, and sampled short/long native-prefix identity for question-only in both development orders.

Compare exact paired functional answers, four values, three roles, stable unchanged facts and ADD-separated updates against original canonical-trained models in each evaluation condition. Equal totals may hide rescues/regressions.

If ordinary augmentation explains an improvement, attribute it to the conventional data intervention. Keep fresh templates, event streams and initializations untouched until a concrete method and confirmation budget are fixed.
interpretation: One paired initialization and the same original train/validation event streams. Only half the training initial-record orders change; per-example positions/lengths/labels and all hyperparameters stay matched. Both already-observed validation orders are development diagnostics, not fresh confirmation. Neither an augmentation gain nor a generic shared bottleneck establishes a semantic interface or isolated recurrent-write damage. Shared must beat independent controllers under the same ordinary augmentation before architectural escalation.
